title: Captured builtins recipe and runtime-authentication escape
question: Can an admitted function's captured builtins change its behavior without changing its reusable recipe or refusing runtime acquisition?
method: Compile two closed synthetic source modules, independently acquire their original-callable ports, then mutate only each function's isolated captured builtin mapping.

results.name: same_recipe
results.note: Complete slices without unknowns independently return 7 and 8.

results.name: post_acquisition_mutation_admitted
results.note: Both acquired ports return 9 after changing only their function's isolated captured len binding.

conclusion: DDO-CA-01 remains implementation-incomplete: static builtin namespace closure and runtime authentication do not cover the callable's actual captured builtin bindings. This bounded probe reproduces the defect and performs no production repair or native/provider qualification.
